purpose: Fixed third seed domain for this observable-dynamics comparison only. No removal, replacement, or post-result seed selection.

survival.duration: First zero fox population after introduction minus introduction step; includes descendants. Null extinction is right-censored at horizon, not extinction at 600.
survival.boundary: P(T >= k) includes extinction exactly at k; alive at k uses T > k. Alive at 600 is separately counted.
survival.quantiles: Linear interpolation (type 7) on min(T,600), including every run. Quantiles at the censoring boundary carry a lower-bound/censored label; actual event-only quantiles are not substituted.

interaction.definition: At least one successful rabbit kill OR plant feeding event during post-introduction steps 1..window (inclusive). Reproduction is separate.

extinctionGuardrails.boundary: First zero population at elapsed step <= window. Species absent at introduction is not applicable, not extinction.

vegetation.collapseDefinition: At least 10 consecutive post-introduction samples below 5% during the first 200 steps; descriptive UX flag, not an ecological threshold.
vegetation.reportAlso: Any sample below 1% within 200; all 600-step mean/median/minimum and run-level distributions.

trajectory.reference: Step 0 introduction has no pre-introduction 50-step window. Use actual pre-action initial metric and label pre-window unavailable. Record endpoint and window-mean deltas, and positive/zero/negative counts; do not claim causal attribution.
trajectory.representatives: For selected Full Web candidate choose nearest to Q25, nearest to median, and greatest restricted duration; ties ascending seed. Keep all runs; export these trajectories only as illustrations.

review.primary: Observable transient dynamics; 600-step survival/coexistence is auxiliary, never a release gate.
review.softTargets: P(T>=100) around >=70%; median around >=150-200; inspect Q25, interaction, 200-step persistence and side effects.
review.preferenceOrder: Keep .67/4 if sufficient; then .67/6; then minimal preference/amount change. Intro 8 requires a clear benefit.
review.sideEffects: Compare rabbit/wolf <=100 and <=200 extinction, vegetation collapse, peaks and cap activity jointly; no scalar score or automatic release decision.
review.pathologies: More than half extinct before 50, repeated cap activity, severe extra early rabbit collapse, or plant-only runaway are rejection signals.
review.additionalScenarios: After all 9 Full Web results, choose 2–3 reasonable candidates and record selection before running Rabbit+Fox and Plant-only (100 same seeds each). Selected default also receives max-efficiency Plant-only (100 seeds).
review.prohibited: No life-history changes, rabbit/wolf changes, new UI, simulationVersion, Apex, leaderboard, Supabase, main merge or Pages deployment.
